evals.name: oat-milk-coffee-naming
evals.prompt: brainstorm ideas for a name for my new oat-milk coffee brand. it's a small batch thing, ethical sourcing, aimed at design-conscious millennials in east london
evals.expected_output: A ranked top-5 list of brand name ideas, each with a one-line rationale, that reflect the oat-milk + coffee + ethical + design-conscious-east-london framing and span clearly different naming angles (e.g. literal, abstract, playful, place-based).

evals.name: empty-office-gym
evals.prompt: help me brainstorm ways to get more people to actually use the gym at my office — we built a nice one but it's basically empty
evals.expected_output: A ranked top-5 list of distinct interventions to drive office-gym usage, each with a one-line rationale, covering genuinely different angles (e.g. a quick pragmatic fix, a behavioral/social nudge, a bold rethink, a human-empathy angle) rather than five variants of 'send reminder emails'.

evals.name: sister-30th-birthday
evals.prompt: brainstorm ideas for a 30th birthday party for my sister who loves hiking and 90s hip hop
evals.expected_output: A ranked top-5 list of party concepts, each with a one-line rationale, that genuinely weave in BOTH the hiking and 90s-hip-hop interests and span different angles (low-key vs ambitious, conventional vs unexpected) rather than five near-identical 'hike then party' ideas.
